headline: Codelco Reports 42,000 Tonne Copper Output Overstatement
summary: Chilean state-owned miner Codelco admitted to overstating copper production by over 42,000 tonnes during 2024 and 2025. The company's chair described the reporting error as a serious matter.
why: Codelco is the world's largest copper producer. Discrepancies in production reporting can impact market supply expectations and the company's financial credibility.

impacts.name: Codelco
impacts.why: The disclosure of production errors raises questions about operational oversight.
